desc: EU leaders meet on 6 March 2025 in Brussels. The meeting is chaired by António COSTA, President of the European Council. The meeting is dedicated to European defence and to Ukraine. Volodymyr ZELENSKYY, President of Ukraine, is invited to the meeting of the European Council.
